description: Use to generate and weigh solution approaches for a problem, after discovery has grounded the context. Produces two or more genuinely distinct options scored on trade-offs, recommends one, and (for code tasks) assembles the enforcement set the rest of the workflow audits against. General-purpose ideation — works for any problem type; not tied to a specific stack.
should_trigger: what are my options for making this consumer idempotent
weigh a few approaches for the payout retry design
should we use an outbox or publish inline, argue both
give me two or three designs for the fee engine
compare ways to handle partial settlement failure
I am not sure how to structure this, what are the choices
trade-offs between polling and CDC for this table
help me decide between a saga and a two-phase commit here
should_not_trigger: find where the outbox table is written
what is the base package of this service
list the Kafka topics this service consumes
